name: Sins of Olympus: Mini Drama
source:
Torn between the past that haunts you and the love that threatens to consume you, you find yourself caught in a deadly game of desire.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一边是挥之不去的往昔阴霾，一边是随时可能将你吞噬的炽烈爱意——在这两者的撕扯之下，你发现自己已深陷一场致命的欲望博弈。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
